slides.alt: A hand holding a hammered silver-colored pan with two ornate shell-shaped handles over a wooden floor. Text: This little copper pan is one of my favorite finds.
The copper underside of the hammered pan with its ornate handles, held in a hand. Text: It once hosted amazing shashuka dishes and who knows what else.
The pan filled with dark chocolate pieces, raisins and walnuts, held by a hand next to a window with a plant. Text: Now it is mostly fit for nuts and fruit.
The pan filled with raisins, almonds, walnuts, goji berries and dark chocolate, held over a woven chair. Text: Until we give her a new tinning treatment for safely cooking in it.
